messages.author: Yuki Nakamura
messages.text: The bulk-grant finding FND-3301 blocks direct grants on the lake until remediation — route the blocked readers through an exception with manager monthly review, not a grant.

messages.author: Elin Bergström
messages.text: Cormac has no manager attestation and the export role is out of scope — refuse it. The exception covers the two attestation-blocked readers only.

messages.author: Aisha Farouk
messages.text: Agreed. Note who is on the exception and who was refused.
